codes.name: A
codes.description: Atomic test/observation (test code or treatment code)

codes.name: C
codes.description: Single observation calculated via a rule or formula from other independent observations (e.g., Alveolar--arterial ratio, cardiac output)

codes.name: F
codes.description: Functional procedure that may consist of one or more interrelated measures (e.g., glucose tolerance test, creatine clearance), usually done at different times and/or on different specimens

codes.name: P
codes.description: Profile or battery consisting of many independent atomic observations (e.g., SMA12, electrolytes), usually done at one instrument on one specimen

codes.name: S
codes.description: Superset--a set of batteries or procedures ordered under a single code unit but processed as separate batteries (e.g., routines = CBC, UA, electrolytes)
